title: Two papers disagree (diet-and-mortality)
explanation: Claim A finds no association between unprocessed red meat intake and incident diabetes, whereas Claim B reports that higher intake of red meat is associated with an increased incidence of type 2 diabetes.
a_text: Unprocessed red meat intake is not associated with incident diabetes mellitus.
b_text: Higher intake of red meat is associated with increased incidence of type 2 diabetes.

audit.reason: Same time-updated red-meat pattern as pair #1: 2010 pooled null vs 2019 umbrella-positive on the same construct.
audit.basis: builder's hand review against the source abstracts (venue, method, population, dose, outcome)
